Free advice, no strings

Three things worth knowing before you buy.

You don't have to buy from me to use these — it's just the stuff I wish every customer knew walking in.

📅

Timing actually matters

End of month and end of model year are when the best numbers show up. Flexible on timing? Tell me — I'll let you know when it makes sense to move.

💰

Know your trade-in first

Your current vehicle is worth more than you think — or less. Get a real number before you negotiate so nobody can move the goalposts. I'll pull it free.

📝

Finance vs. lease isn't one-size

It depends on your kilometres, how long you keep vehicles, and your cash flow. No universal answer — ask me to run both side by side.
